evidence_scope.claims_boundary: This phase records provider build feasibility and unresolved gaps; it is not a reproducible recipe and not a completed source kit.

evidence.claim: The official release asset metadata identifies ffmpeg-8.1.2-essentials_build.zip with SHA-256 db580001caa24ac104c8cb856cd113a87b0a443f7bdf47d8c12b1d740584a2ec.
Official tag 8.1.2 resolves to release metadata commit 46465995c991fe65c5de853fa79bddec09cd6c37, distinct from FFmpeg core commit 38b88335f99e76ed89ff3c93f877fdefce736c13.
The complete immutable release tree contains only README.md and .github/FUNDING.yml; no provider build script is present at this ref.
The immutable repository README states that the Releases section mirrors builds hosted at the official Gyan FFmpeg builds site.

blockers: No complete historical provider recipe is tied to the exact package.
Release metadata commit is not a historical build-recipe identity.
The immutable release tree contains no provider build scripts.

exact_package_metadata.full_configuration_claim_reconciled: The general changelog claim is reconciled with the exact README's 38-entry configuration matrix; that matrix is not an exact configure command.
exact_package_metadata.external_version_claim_reconciled: The general changelog claim does not replace exact-package metadata; the recorded README does not contain external-library versions.

evidence.claim: The exact README hash is recorded and identifies the FFmpeg version, core source reference, a 38-entry configuration matrix, and external-library names, but no configure command line or external-library versions.
Official changelog entry 030 states that package READMEs contain full configuration of internal and external elements; exact-package metadata remains authoritative for the available fields.
Official changelog entry 040 states that new package READMEs list external-library versions, but the recorded exact-package README metadata reports no such versions.
Official asset metadata binds the exact essentials ZIP name and SHA-256 to release tag 8.1.2 without downloading the binary package.

blockers: Exact external-library versions are absent from the recorded exact-package README metadata.
No exact configure line, command environment, or package lock is recorded.

evidence.claim: Official changelog entry 058 states that builds use UCRT64 toolchain and packages and require UCRT for older Windows compatibility.
The official builds page places release 8.1.2 after changelog entry 058, supporting UCRT64 applicability while not identifying an exact compiler or package snapshot.

blockers: Build host and host version are unresolved.
Exact compiler, compiler version, linker, binutils, and supporting tool versions are unresolved.
Exact package repository snapshot and dependency package set are unresolved.

evidence.claim: The exact README contains a 38-entry release-essentials configuration matrix; those entries are not an exact shell command.
General changelog configuration wording does not establish command invocation, environment, paths, dependency prefixes, working directory, or wrapper behavior for the exact package.
General changelog wording about external-library versions does not establish exact dependency inputs or a configure command for the exact package.

blockers: Configuration entries are captured, but no command-line invocation or shell wrapper is recorded.
Dependency prefixes, working directory, and command wrapper are unresolved.
Environment variables, include paths, and library paths are unresolved.
Exact shell configure command is unresolved.

evidence.claim: Exact-package evidence identifies package characteristics but not dependency acquisition, build order, configure invocation, packaging, or checksum orchestration.
The immutable release tree contains no provider build script or historical orchestration recipe.
The repository identifies itself as a support site and release mirror, not as a reproducible build-recipe repository.

blockers: Complete historical provider build recipe at an immutable ref is unresolved.
Dependency acquisition, exact versions, build order, and package snapshot are unresolved.
Exact configure command, environment, paths, prefixes, working directory, and wrapper are unresolved.
Packaging process and checksum generation remain unresolved.
Patch set or explicit no-patch evidence is unresolved.
Reproducible entrypoint and binary-to-recipe correspondence are unresolved.

evidence.claim: No patch file is visible in the release metadata tree, but that absence is not an explicit statement that the core or dependencies were unpatched.

blockers: Dependency patch set and explicit no-patch statement are unresolved.
FFmpeg core patch set and explicit no-patch statement are unresolved.
The absence of patch files in the release metadata tree is not no-patch evidence.
